Headline: Production Technology, NQF 2 to NQF 4.
Target audience: Manufacturing operations managers, plant HR, production supervisors and skills development facilitators in industry
Caption: Production Technology at NQF 2, 3 and 4 — a structured route for the people who run the line.  NQF 2 (SAQA ID 58781) builds foundational technical and operational discipline for entry-level production staff. NQF 3 (SAQA ID 58785) consolidates technical competence on the line. NQF 4 (SAQA ID 58779) supports experienced staff moving toward technical and leading-hand responsibility.  Alongside these, we design customised technical interventions around a plant's own equipment, standards and problems — machine operation, first-line maintenance, 5S, root-cause analysis and quality awareness.  Production Technology delivery and learner registration are subject to confirmation of the applicable current accreditation, registration and enrolment route.  prestigetutelage.co.za

Headline: A structured route from no experience to a real qualification.
Target audience: Employers running youth programmes, CSI leads, community organisations and unemployed young people
Caption: What a learnership actually is, in plain terms.  It is a structured, work-based route to a registered qualification. Classroom learning is combined with real workplace experience, under a formal agreement between the learner, the employer and the training provider.  An 18.2 learnership creates that structure for unemployed learners — proper learning, proper workplace exposure, and human support that keeps people engaged and progressing rather than dropping out halfway.  For employers, Prestige carries the load: learner sourcing, screening, onboarding, learning agreements, induction, delivery, workplace coordination, attendance, assessments, monitoring and reporting.
